items: Mausam ki pesh-goi: mahireen-e-mausmiyat darja-e-hararat, nami aur hawa ki raftar jama kar ke models se mausam batate hain.
Maali andaze: banks aur companies maeeshat ke rujhan, stock prices aur gahakon ka rawayya andaza lagati hain.
Sciencei tehqeeq: models nazariyat jaanchte, naye khayalat dekhte aur pesh-goi karte hain; machine learning aur artificial intelligence ne inhein bare data par zyada taqatwar banaya.

blocks.prompt: Statistical models ka asal duniya ka istemal kaunsa hai (MCQ 6)? Aisa masla bataiye jahan statistical model lag sakta hai (short question 6).
blocks.explanation: (a) gharon ki qeematon ki pesh-goi. Ek aur misal: customers ki tadaad se phal ke stall ki rozana kamai ka andaza, jaise topic 5.4.1.2 mein, ya mausam ke data se kisan ka behtareen bone ka waqt.

items: Istemal: mausam ki pesh-goi, maaliyat, sciencei tehqeeq (ML aur AI se zyada taqatwar).
